question: A shopkeeper has some toys. He sells two-third of the toys at a profit of 35% and the remaining toys at 10% loss. what is his overall percentage of profit?
solution:
Given:

2/3 of toys sold at 35% profit

Remaining toys at 10% loss

Formula:

SP = CP - CP × Loss%

SP = CP + CP × Gain%

Profit% = {(SP - CP) over CP} times 100\% 

Calculation:

Let, Number of toys shop = 3Q

CP of each toy = P

Number of toys sold at 35% profit = 3Q × 2/3 = 2Q

Number of toys sold at 10% loss = 3Q - 2Q = Q

Total cost price of all toys = 3PQ 

SP of 2Q number of toys
